_comment: Frozen from the tree of 2026-08-14 (main 43c1ec53) with
`bun run check:bloat --update-baseline`. Read scripts/check-bloat.ts for what
the two numbers mean and why this is a ratchet and not an absolute bar.
WHY 800 LINES. It is where the concentration shows up. 93 files out of 1.997
(4,7%) are over it, and those 93 hold 156.891 of the tree's 497.049 lines:
31,6% of the code sits in 4,7% of the files. Lower thresholds do not change
the shape, only the size of this file (>500: 169 files / 40,8%; >1200: 50
WHY 20 LINES FOR A CLONE. Twenty normalised lines is about a third of a
screen: nobody types that twice by accident. At 20 there are 15 groups and
426 redundant lines, and all 15 were opened and read. Raising the threshold
to 25 drops the count to 6 and loses genuine finds, among them the three
components that Editor/EditorTabs.tsx and Editor/FilePane.tsx hold byte for
byte (CopyPathBtn, WrapBtn, PreviewBtn).
WHY IT EXISTS AT ALL. In the night of 13-14/08/2026 the two biggest files of
client/src/components/Board produced three semantic conflicts across three
different merges: two branches renaming the same prop, two rewriting the same
state machine, two adding the same function under different names. Git merged
all three cleanly.
RAISING A NUMBER HERE is allowed, in the same commit as the change that grew
it, so the diff shows what the lines bought. Lowering one is free and the
gate asks for it out loud when a file gets cured.
2026-08-15: duplication was raised 368 -> 413 in the commit that added the
two new performance gates, and the two groups that did it are named here so
the number is not anonymous:
- scripts/check-drag-frames.ts <-> scripts/check-session-growth.ts (23 lines):
the CLI tail both gates share, differing only in the payload each writes
into its own baseline. Two callers is where extracting starts to pay, not
where it has already paid; the third gate of this shape is the one that
should force it.
- scripts/check-emdash.ts <-> scripts/check-ui-language.ts (22 lines): the
quote/comment/regex lexer, COPIED. This one is real debt and it is the
kind this repo has been bitten by: the copy's own comment cites a false
positive the original already had to fix, which is drift arriving before
the ink is dry. The two outputs differ today (emdash wants comments
blanked with strings kept, ui-language wants codeOnly plus a literal
table with offsets), so unifying them is a real refactor with both gates'
tests as the net, not a five-minute extraction. Named, not hidden.
2026-08-15, later: `client/src/lib/i18n-en.ts` (906) is the English half of the
translation catalogue, split out of `i18n.ts` so it stops riding in the eager
bundle (that split is what put `check:bundle` back inside its budget without
moving the budget). It is DATA: 900 lines of key-value pairs, and cutting a
dictionary at an arbitrary line number to satisfy a threshold meant for logic
would make it harder to read, not easier. Its sibling `i18n.ts` drops 2096 ->
1210 in the same move, which is the half of this edit that is free.

- client/src/components/Terminal/SingleTerminalPane.tsx:1060-1090 <->

17/09/2026, server/services/ci-evidence.ts a 948 righe. Nessuno dei due rami
che l'hanno toccato la sforava da solo: 680 su main dopo la pulizia delle
bozze (closeCiDraft, contains, closePullRequest, deleteRemoteBranch), 765 sul
ramo del verdetto azionabile (rerun letto da run_attempt, uscita al primo
rosso, sonda del conflitto consumata solo su risposta conclusiva, la guardia
KANBAN-86 che nega il verde su una run rossa). Sommati fanno 948, ed e' la
soglia a essere superata dalla fusione, non da una delle due.
Registrata invece che spezzata, e la ragione e' la data: le due meta' sono
appena uscite da quattro giri di verifica avversaria ciascuna, e spezzare il
file adesso vorrebbe dire rimettere in gioco codice appena provato per una
misura di forma. Il taglio naturale c'e' e va fatto a freddo: il ciclo di vita
della pull request (apri, trova, chiudi, cancella il ramo) e' un'altra cosa
dalla LETTURA della prova (chi legge run e job e ne ricava un verdetto).
Stessa sera, stessa forma: server/routes/tasks.ts da 4.703 a 4.952 (+249, tetto
4.938). Anche qui e' la somma a sfondare — la spazzata delle bozze dopo il land
da una parte, dall'altra il callback che fa arrivare sulla card il link della
pull request e della run mentre la CI gira, invece dei quindici minuti ciechi
misurati sulla prima consegna.
